In addition, the Arctic offers a lowrisk test bed to develop operational concepts for UAS that are difficult to carry out in inhabited areas and are key to making the state-of-the-art advance, e.g., Beyond Visual Line Of Sight (BVLOS) flight and fully autonomous operations [11]. According to the EC, the UAS industry could account for an estimated 10% of the EU aviation market within the next 10 years and create 150,000 jobs in the EU by 2050 [13].
